description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core Web API controller named AuthController that manages authentication-related endpoints such as user registration and login. It interacts with an authentication service and returns JWT tokens.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: Controller handling authentication endpoints including register and login, utilizing dependency injection of IAuthService.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Handles user registration, calls the auth service to create a new user, and returns a JWT token or error responses.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles user login, authenticates credentials via the auth service, and returns JWT token or error responses.
